reason: This diff adds community guidelines, support and private security-reporting guidance, GitHub issue forms and a pull request template, and README navigation. Validation checks YAML syntax and form structure, unique field IDs and labels, relative and repository link targets, and whitespace. exclusions: No application code, dependencies, workflows, packaging, or runtime behavior changes. Python, frontend, native, and Playwright product tests are not selected; documentation and template checks do not establish product behavior coverage. No full suites are approved or run.
